screenshots.name: wh-nomenclature-hierarchy
screenshots.description: Expanded 5-tier hierarchy info panel showing all levels with descriptions and examples
screenshots.desiredState: The collapsible hierarchy info panel at the top of the nomenclature page is expanded, revealing a visual guide that explains all 5 levels (Categories, Product Groups, Sub-Groups, Generic Names, Product Catalog) with descriptions and examples. The 5 tab cards are visible below.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the expanded info/help panel at the top that explains how the hierarchy works — not the tab content below

stateSetup.description: Click the collapsible hierarchy info bar to expand it, then wait for the content to render

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var panels = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=Collapse], [class*=Accordion], details, [class*=collapse]'); return 'Found ' + panels.length + ' collapsible elements'; })()

(() => { var btn = document.querySelector('[class*=hierarchy] [class*=toggle], [class*=info-panel] [class*=header], [class*=HierarchyInfo] button, [class*=hierarchyInfo] [class*=header]'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'clicked hierarchy toggle'; } var allBtns = document.querySelectorAll('button, [role=button]'); for (var i = 0; i < allBtns.length; i++) { var t = allBtns[i].textContent.toLowerCase(); if (t.includes('hierarch') || t.includes('how does')) { allBtns[i].click(); return 'clicked button: ' + allBtns[i].textContent.trim().substring(0, 50); } } return 'no hierarchy toggle found'; })()

screenshots.docReference: Section: Product Hierarchy — hierarchy info panel
screenshots.knownLimitation: The hierarchy info panel toggle selector may vary; may need DOM exploration to find the correct clickable element

mustShow: Expanded hierarchy panel with level descriptions

screenshots.name: wh-nomenclature-categories
screenshots.description: Categories tab (Level 1) showing list of warehouse categories with add, edit, and delete actions
screenshots.desiredState: The Categories tab card (Level 1) is active/selected at the top. The content area below shows a list/table of warehouse categories (e.g., Consumables, Medications, Reagents) with action buttons (add, edit, delete), search bar, and status indicators.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Categories (Level 1) tab content — a simple list of top-level category names with CRUD actions

stateSetup.description: Click the first tab card (Categories / Level 1) to activate it

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var cards = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=TabCard], [class*=tabCard], [class*=tab-card], [class*=LevelCard], [class*=levelCard], [class*=level-card]'); if (cards.length > 0) { cards[0].click(); return 'clicked first tab card'; } var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab], [class*=Tab]'); for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) { var t = tabs[i].textContent; if (t.includes('1') || t.toLowerCase().includes('categor')) { tabs[i].click(); return 'clicked tab: ' + t.trim().substring(0, 40); } } return 'no tab card found — may already be active'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: Tab card selectors may need DOM exploration; the first tab may be active by default

mustShow: First tab card highlighted as active

screenshots.name: wh-nomenclature-catalog
screenshots.description: Product Catalog tab (Level 5) showing detailed item list with code, name, group, category, unit, manufacturer, and quantity columns
screenshots.desiredState: The Product Catalog tab card (Level 5) is active/selected. The content area shows a wide data table with 13 columns (ID, Code, Name, Product Group, Generic Name, Category, Unit, Manufacturer, Quantity, Description, Deleted, Parent, Price Calculation). Filter controls (text search, category dropdown, status filter) are visible above the table. Pagination at the bottom.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Product Catalog (Level 5) — the most detailed table with many columns showing specific warehouse items, not the simpler lists at higher levels

screenshots.name: wh-item-edit
screenshots.description: Warehouse item edit modal showing Main tab with VAT settings, medical item link, generic drug, breakdown, and manufacturer fields
screenshots.desiredState: The edit modal is open over the Product Catalog table, showing the Main tab with editable sections: Basic Config (VAT checkbox, Parent ID), Department Stock table, Medical Item autocomplete, Medical Item Group, Generic drug, Item Breakdown, Medical Heading (country/manufacturer), Tags, Price Calculation. Each section has its own Save button.

stateSetup.description: Ensure Product Catalog tab (Level 5) is active, then click the edit button on the first data row to open the edit modal

(() => { var editBtns = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr button[class*=edit], table tbody tr [class*=ActionIcon], table tbody tr button svg'); for (var i = 0; i < editBtns.length; i++) { var el = editBtns[i]; if (el.closest('button')) { el.closest('button').click(); return 'clicked edit button on row'; } } var allBtns = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr button, table tbody tr [role=button]'); if (allBtns.length > 0) { allBtns[0].click(); return 'clicked first button in table row'; } return 'no edit button found in table'; })()
